Usage of serve:
  -addr string
    	address to listen on (default "localhost:8080")
  -advisory-max-age duration
    	longest the advisory set may go unrefreshed once the queue has drained (0: only on arrival) (default 24h0m0s)
  -advisory-min-interval duration
    	shortest gap between two advisory refreshes, however much arrives (default 15m0s)
  -aggregate-after-edges int
    	dependencies that must arrive before reach is recomputed (default 500)
  -aggregate-max-age duration
    	longest reach may go unmeasured, however little arrives (default 24h0m0s)
  -aggregate-min-interval duration
    	shortest gap between two reach rebuilds (default 5m0s)
  -allow-host string
    	comma-separated request hosts admitted beside loopback, exactly as written, such as a cluster Service name a scraper uses
  -allow-remote-control
    	allow non-loopback request hosts for reads and controls; this does not authenticate callers
  -api-url string
    	GitHub API base URL (default "https://api.github.com")
  -app-dir string
    	directory holding the GitHub App ABOM reads as (default: github-app beside --db; none there reads as you)
  -app-public-reads string
    	account whose installation reads owners the App is not installed on (default: the earliest installation)
  -auth string
    	who may use ABOM: none, only you at this machine; oidc, people signed in through an identity provider such as Entra ID; or github, people signed in with GitHub through the reading App (default "none")
  -authoring-agent-command string
    	command that starts the Copilot CLI in a session's pod (default "copilot")
  -authoring-agent-image string
    	image the Copilot CLI runs from in a session's pod (default: --worker-image)
  -authoring-concurrency int
    	authoring sessions that work at once in a cluster; the rest wait their turn (default 1)
  -authoring-credits float
    	AI credits one authoring session may spend, 30 or more (0: no limit; in a cluster 500 unless given)
  -authoring-egress-proxy string
    	proxy, as a URL, a session's agent reaches Copilot through; the only way out of its pod
  -authoring-limit duration
    	longest one authoring session may run (default 45m0s)
  -authoring-model string
    	model authoring sessions run (default "claude-opus-5")
  -authoring-org string
    	organization a GitHub App's Copilot requests are billed to (default: the App's owner)
  -authoring-worker-cpu string
    	CPU a session's worker, and its agent beside it, each request and may use (default "1")
  -authoring-worker-memory string
    	memory a session's worker, and its agent beside it, each request and are limited to (default "3Gi")
  -authoring-worker-service-account string
    	ServiceAccount the Jobs running authoring sessions run as (default "abom-worker-authoring")
  -authoring-worker-timeout duration
    	longest a session's Job may take, and its grant lasts; a session also ends before its Copilot token (default 1h0m0s)
  -authz-dir string
    	directory holding the key decisions are signed with and the bundle that verifies them (default: authz beside --db)
  -cache-dir string
    	retain fetched checkouts here and reuse each commit across references (default: off)
  -cache-max-mb int
    	ceiling for retained checkouts, least recently used evicted first (0: unbounded) (default 2048)
  -code-scanning-reuse
    	take code scanning's database and default setup's analysis where each is what ABOM would produce; false builds and evaluates everything (default true)
  -code-scanning-wait duration
    	longest a push to an owned default branch whose default setup reads Actions waits for code scanning's own analysis of it before ABOM builds anyway (0: never waits) (default 10m0s)
  -codeql string
    	codeql CLI to invoke (default: codeql on PATH)
  -copilot-cli string
    	Copilot CLI that runs authoring sessions (default: $COPILOT_CLI_PATH; off when empty)
  -custom-ql-dir string
    	directory holding your own CodeQL pack, scaffolded if empty (default: off)
  -database-cache-dir string
    	retain built CodeQL databases here and analyze them again without extracting (default: off)
  -database-cache-max-mb int
    	ceiling for retained databases, least recently used evicted first (0: unbounded) (default 25600)
  -db string
    	SQLite database path or PostgreSQL URL (required; defaults to ABOM_DB)
  -declare-file string
    	local file declaring owned accounts, applied only when nothing is declared (default "abom.local.json")
  -diagnostics
    	expose /api/metrics and /debug/pprof/ for local performance analysis
  -enable-accounts string
    	comma-separated accounts whose declared repositories' default setup may gain actions, once approved
  -enable-targets string
    	comma-separated repositories whose default setup may gain actions, once an approved preview lists them
  -enumerate-every duration
    	how often the declared accounts are re-read for new repositories (0: never) (default 1h0m0s)
  -events-relay string
    	relay channel to read deliveries from, such as https://smee.io/<channel> (default: $ABOM_EVENTS_RELAY)
  -executor string
    	where analysis runs: local, in this process, or kubernetes, as one Job per repository (default "local")
  -expand
    	start discovery as soon as the server is up
  -expand-concurrency int
    	repositories analyzed at once (default 4)
  -expand-interval duration
    	longest a cycle waits before looking for work again (default 30s)
  -expand-lease duration
    	how long a claimed dependency may sit before an interrupted run's work is taken back (default 1h0m0s)
  -expand-limit int
    	dependencies claimed per cycle (default 20)
  -expand-ram int
    	memory cap per codeql invocation in MB (0: codeql decides)
  -expand-suite string
    	query suite to run against each database instead of a single query
  -expand-threads int
    	threads per codeql invocation (0: share the machine between concurrent analyses)
  -github-client-secret-file string
    	file holding the reading App's client secret (default: $ABOM_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET)
  -github-redirect-url string
    	this deployment's /auth/callback, registered as a redirect URI of the reading App
  -github-role-map string
    	memberships as ABOM roles: org/team, org or org:owners, such as acme/abom-operators=operator,acme=viewer
  -github-role-refresh duration
    	how old a role read from GitHub may be before a change reads it again (default 5m0s)
  -group-property string
    	repository custom property to group by on screen, for example business_id
  -list-every duration
    	how often every page of an account is read, which is the only way a deletion is seen (default 24h0m0s)
  -max-depth int
    	hops beyond a seed repository to follow (default 5)
  -oidc-client-id string
    	this deployment's client ID with the provider
  -oidc-client-secret-file string
    	file holding the client secret (default: $ABOM_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET)
  -oidc-issuer string
    	the provider's issuer, such as https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant>/v2.0
  -oidc-redirect-url string
    	this deployment's /auth/callback as registered with the provider
  -oidc-role-map string
    	app role values as ABOM roles, such as Readers=viewer,Ops=operator (default: ABOM.Viewer, ABOM.Analyst, ABOM.Operator, ABOM.Admin)
  -oidc-roles-claim string
    	the ID token claim holding app roles (default: roles)
  -probe-addr string
    	address for a second listener serving only /healthz and /metrics, with no host check or sign-in, for a cluster's kubelet and scraper (default: off)
  -publisher-app-dir string
    	directory holding the GitHub App query exports open pull requests with (default: github-app-publisher beside --db; none there offers no export)
  -ql-mcp string
    	command line that starts ql-mcp for authoring sessions (default "npx -y codeql-development-mcp-server@<pinned>")
  -query string
    	single edges query to run instead of the stored per-tier suites
  -query-id string
    	ledger identity for the query (default "abom/edges")
  -rate-limit-per-hour int
    	git requests an hour for fetching and probing, where Settings saved no rate (0: none)
  -read-replica string
    	PostgreSQL standby URL for pure API reads (defaults to ABOM_READ_REPLICA)
  -read-route string
    	which API reads an account: graphql, rest, or empty to prefer graphql and fall back
  -reader-only
    	serve read-only APIs without acquiring a coordinator lease or starting work
  -recheck-ttl duration
    	how old an analysis must be before its ref is probed for drift (default 24h0m0s)
  -replica-max-lag duration
    	maximum measured standby lag for ordinary reads; zero requires catch-up, writes read back from primary
  -run-worker-cpu string
    	CPU each run Job requests and may use (default "2")
  -run-worker-egress-proxy string
    	proxy, as a URL, the Jobs analyzing a requested run reach out through
  -run-worker-memory string
    	memory each run Job requests and is limited to (default "4Gi")
  -run-worker-service-account string
    	ServiceAccount the Jobs analyzing a requested run's repositories run as (default "abom-worker-qlaas-run")
  -run-worker-timeout duration
    	longest a run Job may take, and its grant lasts (default 1h0m0s)
  -spiffe-roots string
    	CA certificates a worker's identity must chain to (default "/etc/abom/spiffe-roots/ca.crt")
  -spiffe-trust-domain string
    	SPIFFE trust domain workload identities are issued in (default "cluster.local")
  -submit-targets string
    	comma-separated repositories that may receive dependency snapshots
  -test-worker-cpu string
    	CPU each test Job requests and may use (default "1")
  -test-worker-egress-proxy string
    	proxy, as a URL, the Jobs running a query's tests reach out through
  -test-worker-memory string
    	memory each test Job requests and is limited to (default "2Gi")
  -test-worker-service-account string
    	ServiceAccount the Jobs running a query's tests run as (default "abom-worker-qlaas-test")
  -test-worker-timeout duration
    	longest a test Job may take, and its grant lasts (default 30m0s)
  -ui-dir string
    	directory containing the published interface (optional)
  -wait-for-coordinator duration
    	how long to wait for another coordinator's lease to lapse before refusing (default: refuse at once)
  -webhook-secret-file string
    	file holding the secret GitHub signs webhook deliveries with (default: $ABOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET; neither refuses every delivery; an App's own is used when one is configured)
  -work-dir string
    	scratch directory for checkouts (default: a temp dir)
  -worker-cpu string
    	CPU each analysis Job requests (default "2")
  -worker-cpu-limit string
    	CPU each analysis Job may use (default: --worker-cpu; 0 for no limit)
  -worker-egress-proxy string
    	proxy, as a URL, analysis Jobs reach out through (default: none, and each reaches out directly)
  -worker-image string
    	image analysis Jobs run (default: $ABOM_WORKER_IMAGE)
  -worker-instance string
    	the release analysis Jobs are labeled with, so releases sharing a namespace reap only their own
  -worker-memory string
    	memory each analysis Job requests and is limited to (default "4Gi")
  -worker-namespace string
    	namespace analysis Jobs run in (default: this pod's)
  -worker-no-proxy string
    	comma-separated hosts every Job reaches directly rather than through its proxy, such as an object store in the cluster
  -worker-pool string
    	the worker pool analysis Jobs belong to (default "discovery")
  -worker-priority-class string
    	PriorityClass analysis Jobs run at, below the coordinator's
  -worker-s3-secret string
    	Secret holding the object store credentials analysis Jobs read
  -worker-service-account string
    	ServiceAccount analysis Jobs run as (default "abom-worker-discovery")
  -worker-timeout duration
    	longest an analysis Job may take, and its grant lasts (default 1h0m0s)
  -worker-trust-configmap string
    	ConfigMap this server publishes its decision bundle to (default "abom-decision-trust")
